name: Itou Chihiro
source:
A 1st year middle schooler.
A simple girl that is popular with both girls and boys.
She had to quit playing basketball because of an injury, but she's currently working hard as the manager of the basketball club.
She likes [url=/c51801]Hikaru[/url], but she can't seem to tell him her feelings.
